defect: The automatic reminder orders the child to hand back and stop whenever its turn ended without a report. A normally ended turn need not mean the assignment is finished, so the reminder makes unfinished work report completion instead of continuing.

The text does not allow for unfinished work.
fact: A harness can end a turn with stop_reason end_turn before the assigned task is done, for example after a harness failure or when the model asks a question in plain text. So a normally ended turn without a handback does not mean the child has finished, and the reminder should not tell it to stop.
other_facts: The trigger rule (only end_turn turns without a handback get a reminder) is in the diff: report_state in mj-core/src/subagent.rs and remind_subagent_to_hand_back in mj-controller/src/server_runtime/api.rs.

defect: Recover mode treats successfully parsed JSON as a recovered record without validating its digest. A byte flip that preserves JSON syntax is passed to the recovery visitor as fabricated data instead of being reported as corruption.
defect_check: confirmed: visit_relay_journal_reader at intro (src/hel_worker/journal.rs around 478-530) skips a record in Recover mode only when serde_json parsing fails; a parseable record is passed to the visitor with no digest check. Fix 27e5da788 adds validate_relay_event_self in Recover mode.

Err(error) => ... }`. snapshot.rs is not in the diff; at intro snapshot.rs:939 validate_relay_event documents 'Every event is validated by its own recomputed digest' and does `if event.digest != expected_digest { bail!(...) }`. The diff context shows calls to validate_relay_event but not what it checks. Fix 27e5da788 message: 'a byte flip that kept valid JSON but broke the digest would pass through.'

defect: The sanitizer only consumes CSI escapes. For OSC it drops ESC and BEL but emits the printable window-title payload into the transcript.
defect_check: confirmed: sanitize_terminal_text at src/hel_chat/rendering.rs:201-216 consumes only ESC '[' ... final byte; for ESC ']' it drops the ESC (a control character), then pushes ']0;title' because those characters are printable, and drops BEL.
fact: An OSC sequence (ESC ] Ps ; text BEL or ESC \), such as a window-title write from build tools, carries a printable payload that ends only at BEL or ST. A sanitizer that handles only CSI therefore leaves ']0;title' in the text. The sanitizer itself (src/hel_chat/rendering.rs:201-216) is fully in the diff.
other_facts: Tool output shown in the transcript can contain terminal escape sequences other than CSI, such as OSC window titles
evidence: git show efd50a4f0 adds src/hel_chat/rendering.rs as a new file, so sanitize_terminal_text (lines 200-216) is entirely in the diff. What it leaves out is the ECMA-48/xterm escape grammar for OSC/DCS/APC string sequences, which is a terminal standard outside the repository. The fix 6c060035c adds consume_string_body for ']' | 'P' | 'X' | '^' | '_'.

defect: All non-prefix label matches share one score tier. Multiple word-start bonuses can make a scattered subsequence outrank a contiguous literal substring, putting Resize pane down above Toggle transcript rendering for rend.
defect_check: confirmed, with a different example at intro: "Resize pane down" did not exist yet (it first appears in actions.rs by fb0622d0f1). The same inversion holds at intro for "rend". "Restart the Mjolnir daemon" scores 1080 (r +30, e +20, d +30) and "Refresh targets and quotas" scores 1070. "Toggle transcript rendering" scores only 1040, because the greedy leftmost match takes the 'r' in "transcript" and so gets adjacency only for n and d.

A scattered match across word starts can therefore outscore a literal run inside a word.
other_facts: The concrete example depends on the registered palette labels in mj-tui/src/actions.rs, for example "Toggle transcript rendering" (actions.rs:817) and "Restart the Mjolnir daemon" (actions.rs:777) at intro.
evidence: git show 33b58e3c7d -- mj-tui/src/palette.rs shows the full new match_score and subsequence_score, including the 1_000 + score tier and the +30 and +20 bonuses. git show 33b58e3c7d:mj-tui/src/actions.rs lists the labels (777 Restart the Mjolnir daemon, 793 Refresh targets and quotas, 817 Toggle transcript rendering). Fix fb0622d0f1 adds a 5_000 tier for label_lower.find(&query).

defect: The daemon returns its startup-pinned local worker path without checking it still exists or resolving another source. If that build-cache path is removed, subsequent session starts repeatedly fail until daemon restart although a usable source may exist.

defect: The helper puts StrictHostKeyChecking=accept-new before user SSH options. OpenSSH uses the first supplied value, so an explicit strict policy in ssh_args is ignored and an unknown key is accepted.

OpenSSH uses the first value it gets for each option, so a user's `-o StrictHostKeyChecking=yes` is ignored.
fact: OpenSSH takes the first value supplied for a configuration option (command-line -o and config files, per ssh_config(5)), so options placed before the user's ssh_args by ssh_args_with_identity (src/hel_controller.rs:1248-1257) win over the user's later -o StrictHostKeyChecking=yes.

What is missing is OpenSSH's first-value-wins rule, which lives in OpenSSH's documentation and behavior, not in this repository. The fix aa4e0b511 reorders or filters the options accordingly.
